items.mainDefect: The test never joins the reader thread before asserting caughtExceptions is empty, so an exception from the last in-flight read can be added after the assertion has passed.

secondary.defect: Nothing makes the reader thread overlap the deletions, so it can run zero reads and the test passes without testing anything.

items.mainDefect: The test never joins the reader thread before asserting caughtExceptions is empty, so it can miss an exception from the final in-flight read and pass when it should fail.

secondary.defect: Nothing checks that any reads happened before deletedAll was set, so a reader thread that starts late can let the test pass without testing anything.

items.mainDefect: The test never joins the reader thread before the assertion, so an exception from its last in-flight HTTP call can be recorded after the assertion has already run.

secondary.defect: No barrier syncs the reader thread's start with the deletion loop, so the reader may not overlap the deletions at all.
The reader thread is not a daemon and is not always stopped or joined, so it can keep running into later tests.
